title: A Room for the Smile
author: Juniper Nakamura
blurb: Isandro Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
